# Spotify App Remote SDK

`android/app/libs/spotify-app-remote-release-0.8.0.aar` is the official Spotify App Remote SDK, unmodified, downloaded from:
https://github.com/spotify/android-sdk/releases/tag/v0.8.0-appremote_v2.1.0-auth

Copyright Spotify AB. Distributed under Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.

It binds to the installed Spotify application using its built-in authorization and `app-remote-control` scope. No Spotify Web API or Web Playback SDK is used. Playback operations are restricted by the capabilities Spotify exposes for the user and current track. Reading playback state does not imply permission to play arbitrary track URIs.
